Fixture: 07_ma_tree.bin
The MA tree entropy-coded stream of 07_modular_gray_8x8_lossless.jxl

Provenance
----------
  Carved from: JPXL/tests/fixtures/handmade/07_modular_gray_8x8_lossless.jxl
               (see that file's .txt sidecar for the cjxl invocation, the
               libjxl revision and the source-image formula).
  Byte range:  the frame's single TOC section starts at file byte 13 and is
               215 bytes long. Within that section, bit 0 is
               LfChannelDequantization.all_default (G.1.2) and bit 1 is
               GlobalModular's have_global_tree flag (G.1.3), so the MA tree
               stream of H.4.2 begins at bit 2.
  Re-packing:  bits [2, 93) of the section, re-packed LSB-first from bit 0.
               91 bits is what the tree decode consumes; the payload is
               12 bytes with the final 5 bits zero-padded.

Contents
--------
  num_dist 6 (H.4.2 reads six pre-clustered distributions), 26 symbols,
  decoding to a 7-node tree: three decision nodes on property 0 and four
  leaves, every one selecting predictor 5 (Gradient) with offset 0 and
  multiplier 1.

Expected values
---------------
  The `.expected` sidecar records the context sequence and the decoded
  integers. They are not an oracle output — djxl exposes no intermediate
  symbols — but the stream they come from is: the parent fixture decodes
  bit-exactly to a PGM byte-identical to djxl's, which is what makes this a
  regression vector rather than a self-fulfilling one.

cjxl is used strictly as a BLACK BOX (AGENTS.md section 2); no libjxl source
was read to produce this fixture.
